notes.title: Playtest is over. Demo starts now. Thanks.
notes.notes: We are effectively moving the playtest over to the steam app id for the demo because we are part of the Wholesome Games Celebration that just started and they have tools for promoting demos but not playtests. Sorry for the minor inconvenience, but please just switch over to the demo and keep testing/enjoying for another week!

notes.title: Fixed a bug browsing messages after replying to the first in a list
notes.notes: Fixed an issue not being able to flip through messages after replying to the first in a list of requests for comfort, media recommendations or poetry challenges.

notes.title: Add logs to feedback
notes.notes: When submitting feedback, there is a new checkbox to indicate if this is a bug report. If you check that box you will be given the option to submit the current session log file (Player.log). Log files are stripped of personally identifying information (like your system username) before being saved on the server.
